description: This file defines an exception mapper class for handling OptimisticLockException in the Apache Fineract project. It maps the exception to an HTTP 409 Conflict response with a JSON error message.

classes.name: OptimisticLockExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper that converts OptimisticLockException into a HTTP JSON response with conflict status.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an OptimisticLockException to an HTTP 409 response with a JSON error payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns a custom error code (4019) to identify this specific error type.
